data.name: Workflow4
data.value: Capture a field near the celestial pole

data.name: Workflow5
data.value: Rotate only the RA axis by 60–90°

data.name: Workflow6
data.value: Adjust the bolts until the markers overlap

data.name: Workflow8
data.value: Point near the celestial pole and capture the first reference. Plate solving uses the surrounding star pattern, rather than Polaris alone.

data.name: Workflow9
data.value: Keep altitude, azimuth and DEC fixed. Rotate RA only, let the mount settle, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Workflow10
data.value: Keep RA and the camera fixed. Adjust only the altitude and azimuth bolts in small steps, checking the next measurement.

data.name: MeasurementComplete
data.value: {0:HH:mm:ss} measured - adjust in small steps and check the next result.

data.name: Live0
data.value: Check the camera connection, observing site and plate solver settings.

data.name: Live1
data.value: References cleared. Capture the first reference again.

data.name: Live3
data.value: Capturing and solving the reference field -

data.name: Live4
data.value: Calibration complete. Start live adjustment, then adjust the altitude and azimuth bolts.

data.name: Live5
data.value: First reference solved. Rotate RA only, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Live6
data.value: Capturing and solving the next frame -

data.name: Live7
data.value: Measurement stopped. Resume or reset the references.

data.name: Live8
data.value: Measurement failed. Check the error and try again.

data.name: Field3
data.value: Reference image - start measurement to update guidance

data.name: View0
data.value: Resize the image and control panels

data.name: View4
data.value: Illustration only. Actual rotation is measured after capture.

data.name: View11
data.value: Directions describe telescope movement while facing the celestial pole, rather than which way to turn a bolt.

data.name: FocusTip
data.value: Zoom to the alignment markers. Turn off to fit the full image.

data.name: Details
data.value: Celestial Pole: target direction. RA Axis: measured rotation axis. Dashed rings show angular distance from the pole. Hardware accuracy has not yet been verified; atmospheric refraction is not applied.

data.name: StreamingMode
data.value: Native video - latest frame + plate solve

data.name: StreamingHint
data.value: Adjustment only; references use still captures. Every displayed measurement is plate solved.

data.name: StreamingUnsupported
data.value: Requires a connected native ZWO ASI or ToupTek camera. Other drivers use single frames.

data.name: StreamingStarting
data.value: Starting native video and plate solving...

data.name: StreamingEnded
data.value: Camera stream ended. Restart or select single frames.

data.name: FieldRecordHint
data.value: Records start with the first reference. Reset before changing this option. Images are saved for references and Mark only.

data.name: FieldNotesHint
data.value: Add a note before Mark or Stability, e.g. mount untouched, bolt adjustment, or independent comparison.

data.name: FieldMarkHint
data.value: Save the latest measured frame, RAW FITS when available, processed preview and note. Does not take a new exposure.

data.name: FieldRecordingReady
data.value: Field log starts with the first reference.

data.name: FieldScatter
data.value: Repeatability ({0} frames): Alt sigma {1:0.0} arcsec / Az sigma {2:0.0} arcsec. Not absolute accuracy.

data.name: FieldStabilityHint
data.value: Stability collects 20 new frames. Keep bolts, RA, DEC and camera fixed.

data.name: DebugHelp
data.value: Off by default. Applies to the next calibration (Reset first if needed). Records solved-frame data and saves RAW FITS for references and Mark samples in Local AppData/NINA/LivePolarAlignment/FieldSessions. Use Field validation in the imaging panel for Mark, Stability and Folder.

data.name: AutoRaClear
data.value: I checked the {0}-degree path is clear

data.name: AutoRaHint
data.value: Captures both references with the selected RA move between them. Keep Dec and bolts fixed. Direction follows NINA manual controls. Check cable, pier and mount limits first. No automatic return.

data.name: AutoRaUnsupported
data.value: Requires an idle, unparked equatorial mount with RA MoveAxis and tracking control. Manual rotation remains available.

data.name: AutoRaCheckPath
data.value: Automatic rotation is unavailable. Connect a supported mount or use manual rotation.

data.name: VerificationHint
data.value: Keep Dec and adjustment bolts fixed. Takes a fresh reference, rotates RA by the selected angle, then measures again. Check the new path first. Uses the same solver; not an independent accuracy test.

data.name: VerificationResult
data.value: Previous: {0:0.00} arcmin / remeasured: {1:0.00} arcmin. Difference Alt {2:+0.0;-0.0;0.0} arcsec / Az {3:+0.0;-0.0;0.0} arcsec. Keep the mount fixed.

data.name: VerificationComplete
data.value: Remeasurement complete. Review the differences and repeatability before adjusting further.

data.name: DriftFirstHint
data.value: Manually point within 25 deg of Dec 0 and within 15 deg of the meridian, above 25 deg altitude. Sidereal tracking ON; guiding, dithering and corrections OFF. Hold bolts and camera fixed. Records the selected duration (20+ solves). No automatic slew.

data.name: DriftSecondHint
data.value: Without adjusting bolts, manually point near Dec 0 with hour angle 45-75 deg east or west, altitude above 25 deg. Keep sidereal tracking on and all guiding off. Confirm again and record the second field within 30 minutes.

data.name: DriftConfirm
data.value: Guiding / corrections off; mount and bolts fixed

data.name: DriftReady
data.value: Two fields required. No independent result yet.

data.name: DriftFirstDone
data.value: First field stored: Dec drift {0:0.00} arcsec/min. Move manually to the second field.

data.name: DriftResult
data.value: Drift estimate {0:0} arcsec; guarded interval {1:0}-{2:0} arcsec. Shared solver and atmospheric systematics remain.

data.name: AssessmentPending
data.value: Independent verification pending. Target {0:0} arcsec. Available repeatability or remeasurement is not an accuracy certification.

data.name: AssessmentInconclusive
data.value: Inconclusive against {0:0} arcsec. Check pointing / tracking / seeing and repeat longer in steady conditions.

data.name: AssessmentRealign
data.value: Residual exceeds the {0:0} arcsec target. Recheck settings and realign, then repeat verification.

data.name: AssessmentInconsistent
data.value: Checks disagree. Check guiding, tracking, refraction and camera rigidity before realigning. Target {0:0} arcsec.

data.name: AssessmentWithinAvailableChecks
data.value: No excess detected against {0:0} arcsec in available checks. This is not an absolute-accuracy certification.

data.name: DriftPhaseComplete
data.value: Drift field complete. Review the independent verification panel.

data.name: DriftCompletedHint
data.value: Review the result and save the session folder. To realign, turn drift mode off, return manually near the celestial pole and capture new polar references. Nothing is slewed or adjusted automatically.

data.name: ManualRotateBrief
data.value: Rotate RA only by 60–90°, then capture the second reference. Keep Dec and bolts fixed.

data.name: AutoBrief
data.value: Start captures references and rotates RA automatically.

data.name: ManualBrief
data.value: Point near the celestial pole, then press Start. Rotate RA manually when prompted.

data.name: AdjustBrief
data.value: Use the altitude and azimuth bolts to bring the RA axis onto the celestial pole. Keep RA and camera fixed.

data.name: RotationDirectionHint
data.value: ON: N.I.N.A. left / W button direction (default). OFF: right / E. Both follow the N.I.N.A. primary-axis reversal setting; the icon is not a sky-view rotation prediction.

data.name: ImpactCaveat
data.value: Unguided upper bound, not guiding RMS.

data.name: ImpactHint
data.value: Conservative upper bound from polar error and sidereal tracking. Actual motion depends on sky position. Guiding can correct drift; residual field rotation is separate. Seeing, periodic error, flexure and guider performance are not included.

data.name: ManualRotationRequired
data.value: Waiting for manual RA rotation. Rotate only RA by 60–90°, then press Capture rotated field. Live measurement starts after the second reference. For directory simulation, select the RA 90-degree image first.

data.name: CameraRequired
data.value: Connect a camera in N.I.N.A. Equipment before starting. Manual alignment does not require a mount connection.

data.name: ActionStopHint
data.value: Stop the current capture, RA rotation, or live measurement. Wait for cleanup before restarting.

data.name: AutoRaDisconnected
data.value: Connect a mount to enable automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaParked
data.value: Mount is parked. Unpark it in N.I.N.A. Equipment to enable automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaBusy
data.value: Mount is moving. Wait for it to stop before enabling automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaNotEquatorial
data.value: The mount must be configured for equatorial alignment.

data.name: AutoRaAxisUnsupported
data.value: This driver does not support RA MoveAxis. Use manual RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaTrackingUnsupported
data.value: This driver cannot change tracking state. Use manual RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaRateUnsupported
data.value: No supported RA speed from 0.1 to 1 degree per second. Use manual rotation.

data.name: AutoRaInvalidCoordinates
data.value: The mount returned invalid coordinates. Check its connection and configuration.

data.name: AutoRaDriverError
data.value: Could not read mount capabilities. Check the driver and connection.

data.name: AutoRaPreparing
data.value: Preparing automatic alignment — unparking and checking the mount…

data.name: AutoRaUnparkHint
data.value: Start will unpark the mount, verify readiness, then capture the references and rotate RA.
